accessibility.data_testid: Required on all interactive elements using kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: Maintain the exact visual language of v5-full mock including brand tokens and component styles
Do not add role-switching toggles, it is deferred to a future CR
Ensure all buttons, inputs, tabs, and interactive rows have data-testid attributes
Use Lucide icons matching the v5-full mock
Do not use generic font families like Arial or Roboto; stick to Poppins and Inter
When rendering the Recipe Bulk Editor, implement the expandable rows matching the vanilla JS logic
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
